propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph.
Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes are invisible to git (cannot be tracked or gitignored) and persist locally, causing plan reviews to fail closed without running the LLM.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a named warning instead of failing the snapshot, to repair existing broken clones and prevent blocking unrelated ticket reviews.

The writer continues creating ticket directories before their first event is written (via os.makedirs before atomic rename), accepting that orphans may occur from process death during the staging window, rather than attempting unsafe cleanup under concurrent access.
